title: The reviewer's key stays out of reach
tagline: Untrusted code runs without it; the reviewer starts from main
intro: This release splits the work in two, so the key and the untrusted code are never in the same room.

steps.say: The pull request's code now runs in a job that holds no secret, and it hands over only its findings, as plain text with a size limit.
The reviewer then starts from the trusted main branch, reads those findings as data, and takes its pass or fail verdict from the check's result, never from the text.

outro: A pull request written by an agent can no longer borrow the reviewer's identity to approve itself or act on the repository.
